architecture.execution: single-entry contiguous donor-coordinate island with a single residual exit

transport.exit: 2048-dimensional bridge from donor delta to ColorLM coordinates
transport.known_quality_risk: the bridge has not yet been refit from real layer-44 hidden activations

state_lifecycle.implementation: llama.cpp native hybrid memory owned by llama_context and sequence lifecycle
guards: Neural Block and Neural Island cannot be enabled together
COLORLM_V4_KERNEL_LAYERS cannot occupy recurrent sidecar slots 3, 7, or 11 while the island is enabled
state_lifecycle.scope: This validates the current one-slot, one-sequence service path. Multi-sequence concurrency was not tested.

exact_expert_cache.source_bank: complete quantized expert banks in Vulkan_Host
exact_expert_cache.miss_contract: wait for the selected logical experts to be uploaded before executing MUL_MAT_ID
exact_expert_cache.eviction_contract: pin all experts selected by the current token before choosing LRU victims
exact_expert_cache.upload_contract: queue all misses, update the exact LUT, then synchronize the upload backend once

short_validation.protocol: same request shapes across two sequential single-instance runs; this is a short comparison, not a repeated statistical benchmark

comparison.prefill_attribution: not claimed because the expert cache is decode-only and the prompt rates come from separate short runs

limitations: The Rust sample was capped at 160 generated tokens and is not a completed-task quality result.
The speed comparison has one run per condition and should not be reported as a stable universal multiplier.
Cache hit-rate and upload-byte distributions were not captured in this short validation.
Multi-sequence and concurrent-request state isolation were not tested.
next_quality_gate: Refit the entry and exit transport from real Qwen3-Coder-Next layer-44 hidden activations, then run one short coding task and one tool round before considering an eight-layer island or a second donor island.
